category_fits.label: Business Performance & Growth
category_fits.why_fit: The outlook emphasizes commercial growth and strategic implications for technology and media companies, including projected internet and media revenue growth, segment CAGRs, ARPU comparisons, and forecasts for eSports and in-game wagering.
category_fits.why_not_fit: The report is a broad technology-and-media outlook, not a focused benchmark of company profitability or performance rankings.
evidence_sections: The 9 Most Important Insights for Tech and Media in 2017

category_fits.label: Consumer Behavior & Insights
category_fits.why_fit: The report draws on consumer research about media multitasking, attention, spending, willingness to pay for Pay TV, and subscription-app user profiles.
category_fits.why_not_fit: Consumer behavior is a major lens, but the report also centrally analyzes market revenues, platform dynamics, and industry forecasts rather than focusing solely on audience behavior.
evidence_sections: The 9 Most Important Insights for Tech and Media in 2017

category_fits.label: Technology & Innovation
category_fits.why_fit: The report examines digital platform control over access and discovery, messaging and bots as emerging interfaces, and technology shifts affecting media businesses.
category_fits.why_not_fit: It is not primarily an infrastructure, hardware, or product-architecture report; technology is treated alongside media markets and consumer trends.
evidence_sections: The 9 Most Important Insights for Tech and Media in 2017
supported_topic_rules: Evidence repeatedly discusses infrastructure, enterprise technology, robotics, cybersecurity, hardware, or major technology shifts.
rule_evidence_sections: The 9 Most Important Insights for Tech and Media in 2017

category_fits.label: Advertising Strategy & Media
category_fits.why_fit: The report discusses advertising revenue growth and platform discovery, including sponsored ads and publisher revenue sharing.
category_fits.why_not_fit: It does not mainly provide advertising planning, buying, investment, or effectiveness guidance; advertising is one component of a broader technology and media outlook.
supported_topic_rules: Evidence repeatedly covers media channels, ad receptivity, media planning, brand lift, investment priorities, or advertising strategy.

category_fits.label: Streaming & Connected TV
category_fits.why_fit: The report includes Pay TV pricing and video streaming among its strategic insights.
category_fits.why_not_fit: Streaming and television are individual topics within a wider outlook; the report does not center on streaming platforms, CTV inventory, or streaming economics.
evidence_sections: The 9 Most Important Insights for Tech and Media in 2017
supported_topic_rules: Evidence repeatedly covers streaming platforms, CTV inventory, OTT audiences, FAST, or television-like video ad strategy.
rule_evidence_sections: The 9 Most Important Insights for Tech and Media in 2017

category_fits.label: Social, Short Video & Creator
category_fits.why_fit: The report discusses social networks as part of the platform landscape and includes video among its media topics.
category_fits.why_not_fit: It does not center on creator ecosystems, short-form video, or social-content strategy; those topics are not independently central in the provided context.
evidence_sections: The 9 Most Important Insights for Tech and Media in 2017
